title: GTM CS 1:1 prep - Samira Patel
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Samira Patel (CSM)
Date/Time: 2026-06-16 10:00 AM PT
Location: Zoom / Samira's calendar
Purpose: Weekly sync — account health, renewal prep, escalation status, and next steps for Dedicated deployment

Quick context / background:
- Account: Omega Health (Healthcare SaaS) — using hosted API since 2025-09.
- ARR: ~$420k annualized. Renewal target: Q4 2026 renewal discussion starting now (goal: secure 12-month renewal + Dedicated pilot conversion).
- Current usage: steady growth + spike in May after new feature rollout; 95th pct latency incidents reported by customer on Gen-2 model path.
- Open tickets: CS-1283 (inference latency on long-context workflows), ENG-RTE follow-up with SRE.
- Exec sponsor: CTO (Anita Rao) — wants cost analysis and predictable latency SLO for pilot.

Priority agenda items:
1) Health check: usage trends, NPS/CSAT signals, open issues summary (5-7 min)
   - Ask Samira for latest support thread highlights and any sentiment from product owners.
2) Latency escalation (CS-1283) status (7-10 min)
   - What did SRE/serving-runtime say? Any temporary mitigations in place (route to smaller seq len model / batching adjustments)?
   - Decide next escalation steps: engineering executive sync, customer-facing bulletin, or targeted canary with Dedicated nodes.
3) Dedicated pilot ask (10 min)
   - Goal: propose a 90-day Dedicated pilot for predictable latency and cost forecasting.
   - Prep items: cost delta doc, expected throughput, SLA language draft, and pilot acceptance criteria.
   - Who will own the pilot playbook? (Recommend Samira owner + Ryan support for commercial terms.)
4) Renewal timeline / commercial strategy (7 min)
   - Target decision window: start formal renewal conversation Aug 1 — aim to close by Oct 15.
   - Upsell opportunities: Dedicated, longer retention for observability, support premium.
5) Prep for exec sponsor meeting (10 min)
   - Key slides to prepare: usage trends, incident impact analysis, Dedicated pilot ROI, proposed SLA, and migration plan.
   - Action: confirm who presents to Anita Rao and tentative dates next month.
6) Admin / career check-in / blockers (5 min)

Data points I want Samira to bring:
- Recent cadence notes from weekly customer calls (last 3 weeks)
- Current support ticket list with severity and customer impact (short summary)
- Any verbal feedback from Anita Rao or other execs about priorities
- Monthly token usage / cost breakdown for May and June

Talking points / scripts for meeting with customer execs:
- "We see your latency spike on long-context workflows — here's what we know, root causes under investigation, and immediate mitigations we can try while engineering builds a robust fix."
- "A Dedicated pilot will let us guarantee X ms p95 for your typical workloads and give you a clear cost per QPS. We'll run the pilot with clear acceptance criteria and a rollback plan."
- "If you'd like, we can set up a technical deep dive with our serving-runtime team next week to walk through KV cache usage and batching choices."

Proposed action items (owner -> action -> due):
- Samira Patel -> Share distilled support ticket list + customer sentiment one-pager -> Due: 2026-06-17
- Ryan Cho -> Build a one-page Dedicated pilot costs/benefits (high level) and template SLA -> Due: 2026-06-18
- Ryan Cho -> Draft slides for exec sponsor meeting (4 slides: usage, incidents, pilot ROI, next steps) -> Due: 2026-06-22
- Samira Patel -> Confirm availability for exec meeting with Anita Rao and propose 2 dates -> Due: 2026-06-19
- Eng/SRE (contact: Aaron Li) -> Provide short root-cause update for CS-1283 and estimated timeline for fix -> Requested by Ryan via escalation -> Due: 2026-06-18
- Samira Patel -> Schedule technical deep dive with serving-runtime (invite: Ryan, Aaron Li, solutions engineering) -> Due: 2026-06-20

Potential risks / notes:
- If latency persists, risk of customer exploring competitor Dedicated offerings — need clear timeline and mitigation.
- Procurement cycle for healthcare customers tends to be slow (legal/compliance gating). Start procurement conversation early.
- Exec buy-in hinges on clear cost delta and SLA language — prioritize simple, conservative commitments.

Follow-up after our 1:1 (what I'll send):
- Consolidated action item list + owners/dates
- Draft Dedicated pilot one-pager and exec slides (first pass)
- Ask Samira to introduce me to customer procurement lead if exec meeting confirmed

Notes to self (things to prepare before 1:1):
- Pull May/June usage graphs from console (token counts, p95/p99 latencies)
- Quick cost model: hosted vs dedicated at expected QPS (back-of-envelope)
- Re-read CS-1283 ticket thread and SRE notes

Open questions to ask Samira during the 1:1:
- Has the customer accepted any internal workaround (e.g., batching on their side) yet?
- Are there any timeline constraints from their side (budget cycle, product launch) that we should align to?
- Who will be the technical counterpart if we run a Dedicated pilot?

---
Tone: collaborative, solution-oriented, set clear owners. Keep the 1:1 focused on removing blockers for the pilot and securing exec alignment.
